mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id AS historyId, h.user_id AS userId, h.message_id AS messageId, h.order_id AS orderId, h.message_detail AS messageDetail, h.time, h.is_read AS isRead, s.stock_name AS stockName, m.message_content AS messageContent, m.message_type AS messageType, o.transaction_type AS transactionType, o.quantity AS quantity, o.order_price AS orderPrice, (o.quantity * o.order_price) AS totalAmount FROM history h INNER JOIN message m ON h.message_id = m.message_id LEFT JOIN stock_order o ON h.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN stock s ON o.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.time DESC
